members.name: parent
members.description: If set, will adapt parent transform. Make sure the parent has a higher priority so it updates in order.

members.name: rotation
members.description: The object's local rotation in radians.

members.name: angleX
members.description: Rotation on the X axis in degrees. This is a proxy, so operations like += are not supported, use angleX = angleX + 10 instead.

members.name: angleY
members.description: Rotation on the Y axis in degrees. This is a proxy, so operations like += are not supported, use angleY = angleY + 10 instead.

members.name: angleZ
members.description: Rotation on the Z axis in degrees. This is a proxy, so operations like += are not supported, use angleZ = angleZ + 10 instead.

members.name: transform
members.description: The global transform for this Object, it encodes position, rotation and scale in a 4x4 matrix.

members.name: globalPosition
members.description: The object's position in global (world) space.

members.name: globalRotation
members.description: The object's rotation in global (world) space.

members.name: globalScale
members.description: The object's scale in global (world) space.

functions.name: new
functions.description: Creates a new FoxObject at the given position.

functions.name: setRotation
functions.description: Sets the object's rotation in radians.

functions.name: setAngle
functions.description: Same as setRotation() but for angle degrees.

functions.name: setAngleFromVector
functions.description: Sets the object's angle degrees from a Vector3D.

functions.name: getAngle
functions.description: Gets the object's rotation as degrees, as a Vector3D. Pass an output vector to avoid allocating a new one.

functions.name: setRotationQuaternion
functions.description: Sets the object's rotation from a Quaternion, needed for accurate rotation representation when interpolating.

functions.name: setRotationQuaternionFromVector
functions.description: Sets the object's rotation from a Quaternion given as a Vector3D (x, y, z, w).

functions.name: copyComponentsFrom
functions.description: Copies position, rotation and scale from another FoxObject, so the other object's components don't affect this one when changing them.

functions.name: update
functions.description: Updates this object's transform matrix, applying parent transforms if any.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Destroys this object and clears its parent reference.
